hypothesis: Shape the Cartesian normal reference on the unchanged final taught descent so that estimated link/rigid-box normal speed tracks the still-descending taught velocity instead of reversing. Coefficients fitted only to encoder/JTS reconstructed link geometry, taught references and known mass; table force, actual free-box/link state, measured motor torque and impacts are never fitting targets.
objective: Weighted normal-only least squares. Independently fit servo/torque common four amplitudes (no branch by fitted case); time-weight final 40ms of grip 3 versus 1 elsewhere. Match the taught vertical velocity over 9ms from heights; units mm, mm/s *0.040s and position error *0.35. Per-amplitude ridge penalty 0.30 mm per stacked row RMS; symmetric signed probes. Reduce the fitted vector by one common factor until prescribed offset, speed and acceleration bounds all hold. No refit after physical or detection review.
policy: First evaluate efficacy and all gates on previously unused held normal/impact groups; if any fails stop without retuning or new unseen credit. Score plant state only offline. Raw public-observable training curves and analysis evidence stay local.
